title: Allocate Mailboxes
description:
You are given:

An array houses, where each value is the position of a house on a line
An integer k = number of mailboxes you can place
Task

Place k mailboxes anywhere on the line such that:

Every house is assigned to its nearest mailbox
The total distance from each house to its nearest mailbox is minimized

Return this minimum total distance

Key Idea
Each house uses the closest mailbox
You can place mailboxes at any position (not necessarily at house positions)
input_format: The first line contains an integer n, the number of houses. The second line contains n space-separated integers representing the positions of the houses. The third line contains an integer k, the number of mailboxes.
output_format: Print a single integer representing the minimum total distance.
constraints:
1 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 100
1 ≤ houses[i] ≤ 10000
All house positions are unique
